facts.fact: 格洛丽亚四十岁获教席、四十一岁任系主任，早知道丈夫有情况，只是还不知道对方是谁。
facts.anchor: Professor Gloria Jessop knew about the girl, of course she did. She had not been given a chair at the early age of forty

facts.fact: Aiden 见完“Dave”回家心情很好，身上一股浓重的酒馆味。
facts.anchor: He was in a good mood when he came home that night, after meeting ‘Dave’, and smelled strongly of the pub.

facts.fact: 他给不存在的朋友编了全名 Dave Spencer，说两人曾一起打板球。
facts.anchor: ‘You don’t know him. Dave Spencer. I used to play cricket with him.’

facts.fact: 最终把女孩名字告诉 Gloria 的是 Marie Hollingworth 博士。
facts.anchor: It was Dr Marie Hollingworth who finally supplied her name.

facts.fact: Marie 把 Emily 描述成穿紧身牛仔裤、有点风骚的二年级学生。
facts.anchor: ‘Second-year student who wears the tight jeans, yes? Bit tarty, if you know what I mean.

facts.fact: Marie 说一两次看见 Emily 独自从 Aiden 的办公室出来。
facts.anchor: Seen her come out of Aiden’s office on her own once or twice

facts.fact: Gloria 回想两人最近一次性生活可能是夏天在彭布罗克郡，至少四个月前。
facts.anchor: On their summer holiday in Pembrokeshire, perhaps? That was at least four months ago.

facts.fact: Crawley 家新年夜请柬寄给他们两人，名字并排写作“Gloria and Aiden”。
facts.anchor: the Crawleys’ New Year’s Eve party, addressed to them both, their names side by side: ‘Gloria and Aiden’
